name: RAVENEA
description: RAVENEA is a benchmark for retrieval-augmented visual culture understanding, focusing on culture-aware multimodal retrieval and downstream tasks such as culture-focused visual question answering and culture-informed image captioning. It integrates over 11,396 Wikipedia documents curated by human annotators to enhance cultural grounding.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with emerging interest in culture-aware multimodal retrieval and grounded VQA/captioning, but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Demonstrates benefits of culture-aware retrieval augmentation; reveals performance variation across countries.
